name: Log the call
summary: Writes a short summary and the outcome of each call to your own system, a spreadsheet or a CRM, once, near the end of the call.

defaults.name: base_url
defaults.label: Log address
defaults.help: Where each call's summary is sent (POST, with the summary, the outcome, the caller's name and the session).

instructions_snippet: Near the end of the call, once you know the outcome, log the call once with {{ kit.tool.log }}: a two-sentence summary, the outcome and the caller's name if they gave it. Do not tell the caller about the log.

rules.label: Note that the call was logged

test_case.name: Logs the call once
test_case.persona_instructions: You are a customer asking about opening hours. You are happy with the answer and say goodbye.
test_case.scenario: Ask when the office is open, then end the call.
expectations: The agent answers the question and ends the call politely.

variants.label: Your own system
variants.summary: Sends the summary to your system's address (a key is optional, and without one the call carries no key).

definition.name: {{ kit.prefix }}_call
definition.description: Log this call once, near the end: a short summary, the outcome and the caller's name if known.

summary.description: Two sentences: what the caller wanted and what happened.

caller_name.description: The caller's name, if they gave it.

variants.label: A connected spreadsheet or CRM
variants.summary: Adds a row or record with a connected app's action (Google Sheets or Airtable). Connect the app under Apps first, then fix the sheet or table in the tool's settings.
